data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (IMDb details, then Tomatometer, then an email with the same subject and body templates), but it ends with "Send the email" when the true workflow never sends and clicks Discard, and it adds a friend_email parameter where the true workflow derives the address as {friend}@example.com. It is also vague about the tab and UI interactions, so an automation built from it would be partly wrong and could send mail.
